actions.description: The Adaptation Plan soundly operationalizes validated governance changes into behavioral, tooling, and workflow modifications, and explicitly tailors updates to affected Subsidiary Management Plans feeding back to the Project Management Plan -- approve it for rollout

The Adaptation Plan introduces ungrounded workflow disruptions, violates architectural boundaries, or fails to specify which management plans require updates following governance changes -- reject it outright
The Adaptation Plan requires clearer transition milestones, risk mitigations, or more precise tailoring of subsidiary management plan updates before execution

metadata.decision_context: Given a drafted Adaptation Plan translating governance changes into operational adjustments and tailoring subsidiary management plan updates feeding the PMP, decide whether to approve rollout, reject it, or request revision before deciding

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
